query/name: Planets with period, semi-major axis and star mass (pscomppars)
query/params: {"query":"select pl_name,hostname,pl_orbper,pl_orbsmax,st_mass,st_rad,sy_dist,sy_pnum,discoverymethod,disc_year from pscomppars where pl_orbper is not null and pl_orbsmax is not null and st_mass is not null","format":"json"}
